newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -FTSE to push steadily up towards 4,410.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -FTSE to push steadily up towards 4,410.

text.p: The FTSE 100 index may push towards 4,410 on Tuesday continuing its steady performance from yesterday, technical analysts said.

Despite the nervousness surrounding Thursday's election and the unsettled state of U.S. equities, investors in the UK have kept faith in the London market and the FTSE looks like retaining its place above 4,350 near-term although choppy times may be just around the corner, they added.
By 0815 GMT, at the pre-market open the FTSE was indicated up 1.5 at 4,391.2.
The key to the market's success today will continue to be stocks in the financial sector but pharmaceuticals should also do well, analysts said.

Following yesterday's 20 point advance it would be folly to write off the market just yet although its slow progress also highlights the size of task it faces in trying to conquer its record intra-day high at 4,466.3.

The lack of volume of shares traded yesterday exposes the investor uncertainty about committing more funds into the market ahead of the election and this may be the calm before the storm prior to the result being known and its implications analysed.
